boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented SUNY Oneonta traditions, from the Old Main pillars ritual to annual campus celebrations and student showcases.

cards.title: Pass Through the Pillars
cards.subtitle: Old Main pillars, Academic Quad
cards.notes: Join the entering or graduating class procession through the preserved Old Main pillars; graduates walk the route in the opposite direction.
cards.short_summary: A bookend ritual marking the start and close of a SUNY Oneonta journey.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta documents Pass Through the Pillars as a tradition in which new students pass through at the beginning of college and seniors pass through again before graduation.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled with new-student welcome programming and graduating-senior celebrations; follow official university event announcements.

cards.title: Opening Picnic
cards.subtitle: Campus welcome celebration
cards.notes: Look for the Opening Picnic during the start-of-year welcome period and use it as a low-pressure way to meet campus community members.
cards.short_summary: A named opening-of-term gathering in SUNY Oneonta’s tradition lineup.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta identifies the Opening Picnic among the traditions that make Oneonta distinctive.
cards.access_notes: Timing and location vary by academic year; consult official welcome-week communications.

cards.title: Red Day
cards.subtitle: Campus-wide Red Dragon spirit event
cards.notes: Wear red and check the university’s event notices for the day’s activities, entertainment and giveaways celebrating Oneonta school spirit.
cards.short_summary: A fall school-spirit day centered on the Red Dragon community.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta defines Red Day as a fall campus-wide school-spirit event with activities, entertainment and giveaways.
cards.access_notes: Held each fall according to the university style guide; confirm the current date and programming through official announcements.

cards.title: Halloween in the Halls
cards.subtitle: Residence-hall seasonal programming
cards.notes: Watch residence-life communications for Halloween in the Halls and attend only the listed, supervised activities available to your community.
cards.short_summary: A named Halloween-season tradition in SUNY Oneonta’s campus calendar.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta lists Halloween in the Halls among the traditions that make Oneonta, Oneonta.
cards.access_notes: Availability is tied to residence-hall programming; consult the current official residence-life or event communication.

cards.title: OH-Fest
cards.subtitle: SUNY Oneonta and Hartwick College spring festival
cards.notes: Check the official program for the spring festival’s live music, carnival rides and community activities, organized with Hartwick College.
cards.short_summary: A cross-campus spring festival shared with Oneonta’s neighboring college.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta describes OH-Fest as an annual spring festival organized with Hartwick College and featuring live music, carnival rides and community activities.
cards.access_notes: Held in spring; programming and participation details are announced for each year by the organizers.

cards.title: Late-Night Breakfast
cards.subtitle: Dining Services finals-week event
cards.notes: During each semester’s finals period, check Dining Services announcements for the Late-Night Breakfast and its current participation details.
cards.short_summary: A finals-time dining event designed as a pause during exam preparation.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta Dining Services calls Late-Night Breakfast, held before finals each semester, a notable campus tradition.
cards.access_notes: Held before finals each semester; verify the current dining location, time and eligibility with Dining Services.

cards.title: Club Expo
cards.subtitle: Also called eXpo
cards.notes: Visit the Club Expo at the beginning of a semester to speak with student organizations and collect current information on joining them.
cards.short_summary: A twice-yearly organization fair that anchors the start of each semester.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta documents Club Expo, or eXpo, as a twice-annual semester-start event where clubs table with information and signups.
cards.access_notes: Usually held in Alumni Field House or the Hunt Union Ballroom; confirm the semester’s location and schedule officially.

cards.title: Founders’ Day/Week
cards.subtitle: Autumn anniversary of the 1889 founding
cards.notes: Use Founders’ Day or Week programming to connect today’s campus with the 1889 Oneonta State Normal School founding commemorated each autumn.
cards.short_summary: An autumn observance of SUNY Oneonta’s institutional beginning.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta defines Founders’ Day/Week as the autumn anniversary of its 1889 founding as the Oneonta State Normal School.
cards.access_notes: Observed in autumn; follow official university communications for the current year’s events.

cards.title: Alumni Weekend
cards.subtitle: Annual spring alumni and community gathering
cards.notes: Browse the official Alumni Weekend schedule for reunions, performances and sports events that bring students, alumni and the community together.
cards.short_summary: A spring reunion tradition connecting current campus life with alumni.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta describes Alumni Weekend as an annual spring event with sports events, performances and reunions for students, alumni and the community.
cards.access_notes: Held annually in spring; individual activities and participation requirements are published with each year’s schedule.

cards.title: Annual Fashion Show
cards.subtitle: Produced by the Student Fashion Society
cards.notes: Attend the spring show to see student-designed, constructed and modeled clothing lines, with top designers selected by a judging panel.
cards.short_summary: A student-produced runway showcase with more than 25 years of campus history.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta says its Student Fashion Society’s annual spring fashion show has been a campus tradition for more than 25 years.
cards.source_title: SUNY Oneonta Fashion and Textiles Major
cards.access_notes: Produced each spring by the Student Fashion Society; verify the current venue, ticketing and attendance details with official event information.
